judgements.why: Entry point for the learner; establishes what problem these algorithms solve before diving into mechanisms.

Bridge from single-decree to practical Paxos; explains why stable leader avoids repeated Phase 1.

Frames why Raft exists; learner's purpose includes articulating trade-offs, starting with understandability goal.
Fundamental Raft concept; learner must understand terms as logical clocks for leader validity.
Explicitly requested worked example; learner traces election timeout, RequestVote, vote granting.
Explicitly requested worked example; learner traces AppendEntries, matching, commit index advancement.

exclusions.topic: Formal correctness proofs (safety/liveness proofs for Paxos and Raft)
exclusions.consequence: Learner cannot verify why the algorithms are correct or construct proof sketches; they must accept guarantees on authority.
exclusions.when_to_learn: When implementing a consensus library, debugging subtle correctness bugs, or doing graduate-level distributed systems coursework.

exclusions.topic: Other consensus algorithms (Zab, Viewstamped Replication, Chain Replication, etc.)
exclusions.consequence: Learner cannot evaluate alternatives for specific deployment constraints or recognize algorithm lineage in systems like ZooKeeper, etcd, or Kafka.
exclusions.when_to_learn: When choosing a consensus protocol for a new system, or studying the evolution of consensus in production systems.

exclusions.topic: Implementation-level details (RPC framing, persistence, byte-level protocol, batching, pipelining)
exclusions.consequence: Learner cannot build a production-ready implementation or debug protocol-level issues in existing implementations.
exclusions.when_to_learn: When implementing Raft/Paxos from scratch, contributing to etcd/Consul/TiKV, or troubleshooting performance anomalies.

exclusions.topic: Advanced membership change protocols (single-server changes, learner promotion, pre-vote)
exclusions.consequence: Learner cannot safely operate cluster membership changes in production or understand all edge cases in the Raft dissertation.
exclusions.when_to_learn: When operating a Raft cluster in production, or implementing membership changes in a custom Raft library.

exclusions.topic: Lease reads, read-index, and follower reads optimization
exclusions.consequence: Learner cannot design low-latency read paths or understand how production systems scale read throughput.
exclusions.when_to_learn: When optimizing read latency in a Raft-based system, or designing a system that serves reads from followers.
